sophisticated_gem_case.gui.back_descript:
Close Gem Case and return to the backpack screen.
Stored gems, transfer filters and material settings are retained.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.back_detail: Close Gem Case and return to the backpack.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.back_detail_e: Stored gems and settings are retained.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.filter_help: Include/exclude matches both type and purity.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.insert_descri:
Store the gems held on your mouse cursor directly in Gem Case. You do not need to place them in the backpack first.
Gems are added to the matching type and purity. Excess gems and gems the case cannot handle remain on your cursor.
This is a manual action. Transfer switches and type or purity filters do not restrict it.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.insert_detail: Store the gems held on your cursor.
Any remainder stays on your cursor.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.move_descript:
Move all supported gems from the backpack contents into Gem Case. This does not take items from your player inventory or external chests.
Gems are added to the matching type and purity. Other items, unsupported gems and excess amounts stay where they are.
This manual action works even when transfer is OFF and ignores the transfer type and purity filters.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.move_detail: Move gems from your backpack into the case.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.move_detail_e: Other items and excess gems stay in place.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.processing_su:
Choose whether upgrading may also use materials from the backpack contents when the material slots on the left are insufficient.
ON: first check whether the left material slots are sufficient. If not, also consider materials in the backpack.
OFF: use only the left material slots. Materials elsewhere in the backpack will not be used.
Toggling this option does not consume materials. Required materials are consumed when an upgrade is actually performed.
Use backpack contents for missing materials.
Click to toggle. Dedicated materials are used first.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_all: All gems apply (selection below is ignored)
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_axe: If both axes are selected, their combination matches.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_emp: An empty axis does not restrict type or purity.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_ina: Choose Only selected or Except selected to edit.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_no_: Select gems to keep in the case
Select gems to skip when restocking
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_rul:
Click to toggle this type or purity. Gold frames and checkmarks show selection, not whether any gems are owned.
Only selected gems transfers matches. Except selected gems keeps matches out of the transfer and allows all others.
If both types and purities are selected, a gem must match both. Type A plus Flawless matches only Flawless gems of A.
An empty axis is unrestricted. Type A alone matches all purities of A; Flawless alone matches Flawless gems of every type.
If both axes are empty, Only selected gems matches none, while Except selected gems allows all gems.
Selections belong to the current Deposit or Restock direction. Searching or changing pages does not deselect hidden entries.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.selection_unk:
This saved filter entry has no available type or purity definition in the current mod setup.
It can be deselected, but an undefined entry cannot be selected again.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.settings_desc:
Open settings for sending case gems to external storage or collecting gems from it.
Deposit and Restock have separate switches and filters. Choose gem types, purities, or a combination of both.
These settings do not start a transfer. The matching Deposit or Restock upgrade in this backpack performs it.
These filters do not affect Store held gems or Move backpack gems.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.settings_deta: Choose gems for Deposit and Restock.
The matching transfer upgrade is required.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.settings_help: Select entries to change the filter
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.title: Gem Case
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_back:
Return to the gem browser and stored counts.
Filter changes are retained. There is no separate Save button to press before leaving.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_depo:
Edit which gems may leave Gem Case for storage targeted by the Deposit upgrade.
Turn Auto transfer ON for this direction and set the desired type and purity rules. Restock settings are independent.
An enabled Deposit upgrade in this backpack performs the actual transfer. Opening or editing this screen does not move gems.
Gems that the destination cannot accept remain in the case.
Choose which case gems go to external storage.
The Deposit upgrade performs the transfer.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_enab:
Choose whether Gem Case participates in transfers in the currently selected direction.
ON: the matching Deposit or Restock upgrade may transfer case gems that match this filter.
OFF: case gems are not transferred in this direction. Selections are retained and apply again when switched ON.
Deposit and Restock switches are independent. This does not disable the backpack upgrade itself or the manual gem buttons.
ON lets the case participate in this direction.
Deposit and Restock have separate settings.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_mode:
Click to cycle between three filters for the currently selected transfer direction.
All gems: do not restrict type or purity. The selections below are retained but ignored.
Only selected gems: transfer gems matching the selections below. If neither types nor purities are selected, nothing matches.
Except selected gems: keep matching gems out of the transfer and allow the others. If neither axis is selected, all gems are allowed.
When both axes have selections, a gem must match both. For example, selecting type A and Flawless matches only Flawless gems of type A.
An empty axis imposes no restriction. Type A alone matches all purities of A; Flawless alone matches Flawless gems of every type.
Cycle All, Only selected, and Except selected.
With no selections: Only matches none, Except matches all.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_page:
Click the arrows, or scroll the mouse wheel over the icon grid, to browse choices that do not fit on screen.
Arrows move by pages; the wheel moves by rows. An arrow is disabled when there are no more choices in that direction.
Selections on other pages remain part of the filter. The totals count all selections for this direction, not just the current page.
Use arrows or the mouse wheel to browse choices.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_rank:
Show purities from lowest to highest, with their names. The number in brackets counts selected purities.
The displayed gem is only a sample for the purity. It does not limit the filter to that gem type. Gold frames and checkmarks mark selected purities.
With no type selected, the selected purities match every gem type. If types are selected too, only the selected purities of those types match.
The Match option determines whether matching gems are transferred or excluded. All gems ignores the selections and disables editing them.
Icons below run from lowest to highest purity.
Purity applies to every gem type, regardless of the sample.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_rest:
Edit which gems may enter Gem Case from storage used by the Restock upgrade.
Turn Auto transfer ON for this direction and set the desired type and purity rules. Deposit settings are independent.
An enabled Restock upgrade in this backpack performs the actual transfer. Opening or editing this screen does not move gems.
Unsupported gems and amounts beyond the case capacity remain in the source storage.
Choose which gems to collect into the case.
The Restock upgrade performs the transfer.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_sear:
Type part of a name or ID to narrow the currently displayed type or purity choices.
This search only helps find choices. The typed text is not a transfer rule: select the matching icons to add them to the filter.
Selections hidden by the search remain selected and continue to apply. Clear the text to see all choices again.
Switching between types and purities clears the search text but retains selections on both axes.
Filter the choices below by name or ID.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.transfer_type:
Show gem types in the icon grid. The number in brackets counts selected types for this direction.
Click an icon to select or deselect it. Gold frames and checkmarks show selections, not owned amounts. Unowned types can also be selected.
With no purity selected, every purity of a selected type matches. If purities are selected too, a gem must match both axes.
The Match option determines whether matching gems are transferred or excluded. All gems ignores the selections and disables editing them.
Click the icons below to choose gem types.
Gold frames mark selection, regardless of owned count.
sophisticated_gem_case.gui.unresolved_de:
Inspect gems whose records remain in the case but cannot be recreated as items in the current mod setup.
This can happen after removing a mod or datapack, or after gem types or purity definitions change.
The list shows type and purity IDs and their stored counts. Hover an entry to read IDs that do not fit on screen.
Opening this list does not delete records. Unavailable gems cannot be withdrawn or upgraded. Click again to return to the gem browser.
Inspect stored gems unavailable in this setup.
Type, purity and counts are retained.
